notes.title: Patch to ver. 1.2.2.
notes.content:
Exploration & Progression
Rope Ascension removed: The old mechanic where you had to shoot to ascend with a rope has been completely removed. Instead, ladders are now placed throughout the levels.

To climb: approach and press E.

To release the ladder: press E again.
Boss Fights
Adjusted the size of the bosses “Bridge Creature”, “Trinity Creature”, and “The Hanged” so they no longer block the camera view.

All enemies now properly register hits across their full mesh.
Enemies & World
Balcony enemies have been moved into a secret area.
Combat System
Parrying finalized: A feature from the earliest versions (0.8–0.9) has been fully reworked and polished.

To parry: shoot the enemy at the exact timing of their attack. This will put them into a stagger state.

While the enemy is staggered, perform a dash toward them and press E to initiate a finishing move.

Fixed blood effects on enemies. Pulled in older elements: enemies now leave blood pools, and parries/dealing damage cause more blood to appear.

Updated the basic enemy attack chain: now more varied, with new thrusts and more dangerous follow-ups.

A stamina system has been added. Dodges, parries, and weapon attacks now consume stamina.

The stamina bar is displayed under the health bar.

When stamina is fully depleted, the character becomes temporarily vulnerable and cannot perform actions until it recovers.
Weapons & Balance
Adjusted weapon durability: melee weapons no longer lose durability when swinging without hitting an enemy.
Achievements
Slightly reworked some Steam achievements and added a few new ones.
[hr][/hr]☺️ Thank you for playing

notes.title: Major Patch - ver. 1.2.
notes.content:
Update 1.2 is here - a major August patch featuring gameplay improvements, a new location, controller support, boss overhaul, and more. But first, a quick update from the team:
Team Update
The BERENICE development team has recently gone from 6 to 3 people.
We’re now a compact trio: composer, programmer, and 3D artist - pushing forward together to polish the game and bring it to its full potential.
Thanks for your patience and continued support - we’re giving it everything we’ve got.

Now let’s talk about what’s new
[hr][/hr]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578672/4366f7d9d4e30ddf3d364a3c6936b439f760f619.png"]
Controller Support
You can now fully play BERENICE using a controller:

The entire game and menus are now controller-friendly

Control scheme is displayed in Settings -> Controller

We had to adjust the menu structure slightly to support this, but it should feel smoother overall
New Location - Tears District
A new area has been added before entering the Endless Palace: Tears District.
This will serve as a hub space, where quest-related characters will appear in future updates. For now - explore. Something’s already moving out there...

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578672/19fd42d01283a4b57fa219cd311833806303cd55.png"]
Audio & Music Update
BERENICE’s singing has been reworked - richer, more haunting, closer to her intended sound

Ambient sound design added: background music now shifts depending on what spawns in the procedural room (enemies, upgrades, items)

The result: a more reactive and layered atmosphere throughout.


Performance Improvements & Optimization
Baked lighting in some areas

Reduced texture sizes

Simplified materials

Cleaned up level clutter and made some geometry more static
-> All of this gives a performance boost, especially on mid-range systems.

But optimization is still ongoing.


Character Controls
Sprint is now toggled with a single press - no need to hold the button

Herman is no longer locked to camera movement - you can now turn and move freely


New Boss Model - The Hunged One (Palace Vaults Section)
The boss in the Palace Vaults has been reworked to reflect the original artistic vision.
Meet The Hung One - a towering four-legged creature suspended by hundreds of wires in a frozen illusion of order. A monstrous relic of architectural obsession.

Its cracked skin reveals ropes and hooks instead of muscle.
The skull is bare - stretched like a spire.
Once a symbol of stability, now a grotesque monument to control and decay.


Balance Tweak
Mayor of Edinburgh now heals much less - the fight is more fair and intense.


Visual Touches
Small art and lighting improvements across several areas

Minor refinements to level composition (no spoilers)


Localization Fixes
Most issues with English–Russian localization have been resolved.
Menus, settings, UI, and in-game texts should now display correctly depending on your language selection.


[hr][/hr]☺️ Thank you for playing
We're still working — but this is a big step forward.
Let us know what you think of 1.2 in the discussions - we read everything.

- SATORI Ent. Team

notes.title: Major Update - Patch 1.1.5!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578672/e1a238764adae1c556212e58efc57a45e288b364.png"]

What if the world had no boundaries — and the mind, no escape?
The Endless Palace continues to grow.
The immersion is deeper. The illusions are sharper.
The path to Berenice is darker than ever.
[hr][/hr]
Major changes:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578672/18a09fe591cfd08853c256e6e3c297547992678c.png"]

Facial animations for Berenice - she’s closer than she seems.

Final cutscene reworked - the ending now hits harder

New soundtrack added - the Main Theme and other tracks are now available at sat-ent.com

UI updated - a new font enhances atmosphere and readability.

Water physics implemented - the depths of the sunken city now truly come alive.

Map update - a hidden location and secret boss have been added.
[hr][/hr]
Weapon system update:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578672/59dcfe504b6e3c79236b0f86974016a09155f1c6.png"]

Weapons can now be picked up and discarded.

Each weapon has its own durability bar - nothing lasts forever.

New weapons:

Shotgun - high power for close-range combat.

Sawblade sword - tears through enemies, but demands control.
[hr][/hr]
Core change:

The Palace is now truly endless.
It is no longer limited by borders or patterns.
Move forward, and the architecture reshapes around you.
Follow the voice of Berenice...
But beware - each biome now holds its own boss.
Victory is not an exit. It is only the next corridor.
[hr][/hr]
Coming soon:

Hotfixes

New procedural content within the Palace

More lore fragments, puzzles, and distortions of logic

Thank you for walking this path with us.
Even if it leads nowhere.
- the SATORI team
